card.name: Small words after sending or sharing verbs
card.fires_on: Short linking words (to, of, it, and, whom, with) and the word download, right after verbs of sending, sharing or transferring in web text. The pole responds on the word just after the verb or noun.

modes.label: Word after send/share/download
modes.description: A small word follows a verb of sending, sharing or downloading, and a recipient or object comes next.
modes.example: your modifications will be sent<< to>> our editors for review.

modes.label: Linking word in a clause
modes.description: A linking word such as whom, of or with appears mid-clause before a noun phrase.
modes.example: reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs for use in patients for<< whom>> alternative treatment options are inadequate.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come right after verbs like send, share or download.
evidence: your modifications will be sent<< to>> our editors for review.
